description: WHEN: first step whenever the user wants to read from or act on a Dynamics 365 F&O (ERP) environment through this server. Lists the F&O instances you may use (alias, label, whether it is protected like PROD, whether it is readOnly, and whether the user has already connected it). Use the alias as the 'instance' argument of erp_list_tools and erp_call. If connected=false, tell the user to open the connectUrl in a browser, then retry.
name: erp_list_instances
